purpose: Native source-owned authorization and telemetry proof for the two synthetic reference applications, separate from identity/tool/24-hour gates.
software_prepared: Closed finite HTTPS client and known-content/explicit-denial predicates.
Allowed, removed, denied, owner, restored and alternate-grant sequences, with one fixed two-minute defect and mandatory reset.
Separate PostgreSQL source/console databases and non-superuser roles with cross-database connection denial.
TLS source and console process entry points, fixed loopback ports inside the runner, secure cookies and CSRF retained.
One total HTTPS deadline includes TCP, TLS, response and body consumption; expired responses cannot update session or observation receipts.
Exact committed event IDs accompany actual source reads and effective permission changes; no latest-row lookup or observation guessing.

Closed reconciliation binds all 31 fixed HTTP controls to 23 logical source/console events and one R3 case with exact removal/read evidence and a post-reset legitimate-owner control. Memory-only execution passed; native proof remains required.
Finite native runner, actual database/user identity and privilege checks, explicit cross-database denial predicate, fault reset and exact child-process shutdown prepared.

Two-component native recipe parsed using the installed Compose CLI without starting Docker. Closed parsed-profile validation rejects changed mounts, ports, privileges, networks, credentials and resource limits.

Offline short-lived P-256/SHA-256 CA and distinct server keys for 127.0.0.1 only, with strict chain/address/expiry checks. No signing-key serialization, host trust change or installation. Existing bundled cryptography 50.0.1/Python 3.12.14 used for certificate preparation only.

Exact ownership/naming checks, effective resource/namespace/mount/network/volume validators, finite independent watchdog and abort signaling. Hostile modeled controls pass; native enforcement has not been observed.

Runner kernel proof now verifies uid/gid, absence of privileged supplementary groups, zero capability sets, no-new-privileges, seccomp, cgroup v2 quotas and effective read-only source/secrets binds. Kernel checks use offline models pending native execution.

Publication leakage checks include source-profile passwords, distinct database credentials and full/encoded server keys, including recognized interrupted preparation. Unknown files, duplicate JSON fields and malformed credentials fail closed.

Host launcher creates stopped containers first, verifies effective entrypoint/environment/isolation and exact network/volume ownership, then starts only verified IDs. It releases the source execution gate only after revalidation.

Private per-run Windows ACL script limits access to the current operator and SYSTEM, refusing redirected or nonempty initial targets. Syntax and modeled calls are checked; native ACL enforcement remains unobserved.

Host evidence verifier recomputes the selected source snapshot and closed raw receipt hashes, access/event/case reconciliation, kernel facts, database boundaries, fault reset and finite process shutdown. Both scoped shutdown receipts are required.
Direct Windows physical-memory query replaces repeated WMI subprocesses in this source profile. It reads the System32 API only and makes no machine changes.

Private Docker configuration names the existing installed Compose plugin without importing host credentials. Its actual offline CLI parse passed after an initial missing-plugin failure; no Docker service or native component was started.
remaining_before_review: The complete offline regression and frozen evaluation repeat passed. The current source-bound receipt and rebuilt handoff are named in docs/enterprise-milestone.json; earlier failures and source identities remain retained.
Review this fixed source-access profile and fresh disk/memory readings with the user before one native launch. This plan itself does not authorize that machine change.

Native execution must still establish actual private ACLs, container/kernel/TLS/PostgreSQL behavior, reconciled telemetry and both shutdown receipts. Prepared code and hostile models do not establish native acceptance.

database.role: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL volume; never the prior stage volume.

runner.role: Finite native source/console processes and their operator driver; not an independent OS security boundary between those processes.

proposed_limits.note: Proposed guard preserves the earlier conservative baseline. Review current disk/memory before launch; monitoring is not a hard quota.
proposed_limits.watchdog_limit_semantics: Thirty-minute deadline initiates scoped shutdown; individual Docker control operations are bounded. Capacity monitoring and daemon-dependent stopping are not hard quotas or a guarantee against host administrator/daemon failure.

proposed_isolation: Internal network, no published ports or runtime egress.
Non-root, read-only roots, all capabilities removed, no-new-privileges, finite pids and logs, restart disabled.
Snapshot of selected public source read-only; cached six hash-pinned wheels read-only. No live checkout, host socket or other-project mounts.
Separate finite noexec scratch and executable dependency tmpfs; private bounded output and per-run secrets only.
Explicit per-process trust in a disposable lab CA. No host trust-store change, public certificates, downloads or paid service.
PostgreSQL transport remains plaintext inside this isolated component network; full enterprise TLS and production deployment remain separate.
Private IPC/cgroup namespaces; kernel uid/gid/capability/seccomp/quota and source/secrets mount proofs must match the reviewed profile.
intended_evidence: Actual login identity, unchanged session after removal, exact known record predicates, owner/cross-app controls, defect reset and restoration.
Permission-change/outbox transaction evidence, native HMAC/TLS delivery, event ID/digest reconciliation, instrumented provenance and detected R3 regression.
Separate committed outbox claims, initiated transport invocations, unique logical events and logical cases. A committed lease claim does not prove a physical transmission.
Incomplete failures preserved with safe error classes; neither HTTP 200 alone nor a service failure becomes a security pass.
Main and independent shutdown receipts; no cleanup of other projects.

capacity_snapshot.limits: Read-only observation, not reserved capacity. The ordinary Windows CIM query was denied in the sandbox; the separately reviewed read-only query succeeded. Recheck within the approved launch context before startup.

full_preparation_evidence: Inspect docs/enterprise-milestone.json current_offline_receipt; it must pass and match the selected source before reviewed launch.
